english:
John 10:11. I am the good shepherd. to verse 16. one flock and one shepherd.

Then [the feast] of Saint Anton [Anthony] the Anchorite: Tone 3 [ah], "Who excelled" (Or gerazantseal), with its canon. At Midday, Introit: "Anchorites of Christ" (Tgnavork Krisdosi). Patronymic [hymn]: say "Have Mercy" (zOghormean). Psalm 123 [124]: "If the Lord had not been with us." Proverbs 21:16. "The joy of the righteous..." to verse 24. "and he who is vengeful is lawless." Prophet Isaiah 19:19. "In that day there shall be an altar of the Lord..." to verse 21. "and they shall perform." Apostle Hebrews 11:32. "And now what more shall I say?..." to verse 40. "so that they should not be perfected without us." Alleluia, "Blessed are those." Gospel Matthew 10:37. "He who loves father..." to verse 42. "his reward."

Then [the feast] of the Saints: King Theodosius, and the Children of Ephesus: Tone 1 [ak], "Who [crowned] the heavenly," with its canon. Magnificate [Metsatsoostseh] Tone 1 [adz], "Blessed and God-loving." At Midday, Introit: "As after the God-loving." Patronymic [hymn]: say "Have Mercy" (zOghormean). Psalm 20 [21]: "The Lord in Your strength." Proverbs Wisdom 6:2. "Hear, O kings..." to verse 10. "and do not fail." Prophet Isaiah 45:1. "Thus says the Lord God..." to verse 2. "and I will shatter the iron bars." Apostle 1 Timothy 2:1. "And now I entreat..." to verse 7. "in faith and truth." Alleluia, "The Lord in strength." Gospel Luke 7:1. "And it came to pass when He finished..." to verse 10. "healed."

Then [the feast] of the Saints: Cyriacus [Kirakos] and his mother Julietta [Yughita]: Tone [ah], Martyrs, from the proper tone. Verse [Mankunk] Tone 2 [bk], "From good roots." At Dismissal [Hambartsi]: "Rose-colored." At Midday, Introit: "In the temple of the saints." Psalm 8: "Out of the mouths of babes." Chorus: "Lord, our Lord." Proverbs 14:1. "Wise women..." to verse 6. "easily from the wise." Prophet Zechariah 8:4. "Thus says the Lord Almighty..." to verse 5. "in its streets." Prophet Isaiah 60:8. "Who are these that like..." to verse 9. "glorified." Apostle Hebrews 2:14. "Now, therefore..." to verse 18. "to help." Alleluia, Martyrs, from the proper tone. Gospel Luke 9:44. "And they were all amazed..." to verse 48. "he shall be great."

Then [the feast] of Saint Vahan of Goghtn: Verse [Mankunk] and Dismissal [Hambartsi] Tone 2 [bz], "Wonderful is [it]." Midday Psalm 3: "But You, O Lord, help." Proverbs 7:1. "My son, keep..." to verse 7. "among the youths." Prophet Ezekiel 12:17. "And the word of the Lord came to me..." to verse 19. "all its inhabitants." Apostle Romans 8:12. "Henceforth, brethren..." to verse 27. "he intercedes for the saints." Alleluia, Martyrs. Gospel Luke 9:23. "And He said to all..." to verse 27. "the kingdom of God."

Then [the feast] of the Holy Anchorites: Tryphon, Parsamas, and Onuphrius: Tone 1 [adz], "Who excelled," with its canon. Midday Psalm 41 [42]: "With the voice of joy." Prophet Isaiah 41:15 [or 49:15]. "Thus says the Lord: behold..." to verse 20. "made all this." Catholic Epistle 1 Peter 2:9 [or 2 Peter 2:9]. "The Lord knows how [to deliver] the godly..." to verse 15. "they loved unrighteousness." Alleluia, "Blessed are those." Gospel John 9:39. "And Jesus said..." to verse 10:10. "and that they might have it more abundantly."

Then [the feast] of the Holy Patriarchs: Athanasius and Cyril: Tone 1 [ak], "Who adorned." Canticle [Harts] Tone 2 [bz], "Who your boundless." Verse [Mankunk] and Dismissal [Hambartsi] Tone 3 [gz], "New children." Midday Hymn Tone 4 [dz], "Today the heavenly ones." Psalm 131 [132]: "Your priests." Proverbs 11:2. "The mouth of the humble..." to verse 11. "overthrown." Prophet Isaiah 61:3. "And they shall be called..." to verse 7. "of their head." Apostle Hebrews 13:7. "Remember your leaders..." to verse 9. "who thus walked." Alleluia, "Your priests." Gospel John 16:33. "These things I have spoken..." to verse 17:8. "You sent me."

Then [the feast] of the Holy Martyrs: Gordius, Polyeuctus [Poghiktos], and Grigoris: Midday Psalm 115 [116]: "Precious is." Proverbs Wisdom 2:23. "For God established..." to verse 3:8. "reign forever." Prophet Isaiah 16:9. "Therefore I will weep..." to verse 12. "to save him." Apostle 2 Corinthians 5:1. "For we know..." to verse 5. "the pledge of the Spirit." Alleluia, Martyrs. Gospel Luke 21:12. "But before all this..." to verse 19. "your souls."
